content:
alex_m: Heads-up — I'm going to open support requests to raise several networking quotas across prod and staging for the Dedicated GPU fleet launch. Need a quick review before I submit. TL;DR: EIPs, ENIs, VPCs, and account IPv6 enablement in us-west-2 + eu-central-1.

sara_net: Which accounts/regions exactly? and can you list the target numbers you want? need to know staging vs prod.

alex_m: Accounts: prod 111122223333, staging 444455556666. Regions: us-west-2 and eu-central-1. Proposed quota changes per region/account: 
- Elastic IPs: 5 -> 50 (we need static IPs for NAT + some LB mapping during rollout)
- Elastic Network Interfaces (ENIs) quota: 500 -> 2000 (we're density-packing pods onto ENIs via secondary IPs for multi-pod-per-node VPC CNI)
- VPCs per region: 5 -> 50 (we create per-tenant VPCs for Dedicated customers)
- Enable IPv6 support on account (request to enable IPv6 addressing + help with default /56 allocations)
- Increase limit for 'Secondary private IPv4 addresses per ENI' if they ask (we may request 50 -> 250).

jamie_ops: ok. Couple notes: 1) try to avoid relying on lots of EIPs long-term (cost & operational pain). 2) for Dedicated we need static IPs for cross-account peering and on-prem tunnels so EIPs are needed at rollout. 3) we should include rationale: throughput (p4d/g5 clusters), isolation for customer VPCs, and upcoming Canary launch date.

alex_m: Draft support case body (copy/paste):
```
AccountId: 111122223333 (prod)
Region: us-west-2
We request quota increases:
- Elastic IPs per Region: current 5 -> requested 50. Purpose: NAT gateways + static LB allocations for Dedicated GPU fleet; expected peak 24 NATs + 20 LB IPs + buffer for DR.
- ENIs per Region: current 500 -> requested 2000. Purpose: high-density node networking for GPU nodes (p4d.24xlarge + g5.12xlarge) running multiple pods using secondary IPs.
- VPCs per Region: current 5 -> requested 50. Purpose: per-customer isolated VPCs for Dedicated offering.
- Request account-level IPv6 enablement and guidance for default /56 allocations for new VPCs.
Please prioritize with a 3-5 business day SLA if possible; target rollout week: 1773379200 (approx 1 week).
```

sara_net: Add this: mention staging account too and eur-central-1. Also cc security and compliance (compliance@redwood.com) for IPv6 enablement/impact assessment.

alex_m: updated draft with both accounts + regions. Will paste final when ready.

nico_fin: quick cost note — increasing EIP limits is fine but remember EIPs that are allocated but unattached still incur a small hourly charge. NAT Gateways themselves are expensive (per GB + per-hour). If we go from 5->50 we should plan tagging + lifecycle to avoid stray costs. Estimate: if 20 extra EIPs sit unused that's ~$X/month (placeholder, we'll model exact after approvals).

jamie_ops: also note: some quotas for ENIs/secondary IPs are regional and some are per-account; support might ask for exact service quota names. I'll attach a short checklist of quota names to include.

jamie_ops: Checklist (paste into case):
- EC2: Elastic IPs (EC2-EIP-Count)
- EC2: Network interfaces (ENI) per region (EC2-NetworkInterfaces)
- VPCs per region (VPC-NumberOfVPCs)
- EC2: Secondary private IPv4 addresses per network interface (if applicable)
- Request: Enable IPv6 for account (account feature toggle) and advise default /56 allocation steps

alex_m: submitted support case for prod/us-west-2 and staging/us-west-2. Case numbers: PROD: CASE-123456789 (https://console.aws.amazon.com/support/cases#/case/?caseId=CASE-123456789), STAGING: CASE-123456790. AWS responded with follow-ups asking for justification and network diagrams.

aws-support-bot: [AUTOMATED] Case CASE-123456789 updated: "Additional info required: please provide architecture diagram and expected steady-state counts per quota."

sara_net: I'll draft a one-page diagram + steady-state table (nodes, ENIs, expected secondary IPs per node) and post here in a bit.

alex_m: thanks — tagging @jamie_ops for the steady-state numbers.

jamie_ops: steady-state (prod, us-west-2): 120 p4d nodes (avg 4 ENIs used per node via CNI secondary IPs) -> ~480 ENIs + 10% buffer => request 2000 is conservative but safe. NATs: 24 per-customer NATs + 6 shared = 30. EIP request 50 gives breathing room.

nico_fin: also want to make sure finance is notified once quotas are approved so we can model monthly run-rate for Dedicated customers vs hosted.

alex_m: noted, will loop finance in when we get approvals.

deploy-bot: Created internal ticket INFRA-8723 to track quota requests and post-approval tasks (assignments, tagging, cost tags).

aws-support-bot: [AUTOMATED] PROD case CASE-123456789 assigned to Support Engineer. Est. initial response: 24 hrs.

alex_m: great. please ack here when you see the case progress or if anyone wants to tweak numbers.

sara_net: ack. I'll upload the diagram and compliance cc in this thread once ready.

alex_m: thanks all — will follow up once cases update. :thumbsup:
